name: Midlife Crisis
overview: Scripture reminds believers facing the uncertainties of midlife that God has purposeful plans for their lives, offering peace and hope for the future as affirmed in Jeremiah 29:11. The eternal nature of Christ, the Word, underscores that life’s meaning and stability are found in Him (John 1:1). Believers are encouraged to trust God's presence and provision, cultivating contentment and patience through trials so they may grow mature and lacking nothing, as taught in Hebrews 13:5 and James 1:4. This foundation assures that even amid inner struggles, God's faithfulness and sovereign design remain unchanging.
